scale.phenomenon: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength (intra-scale melanophore territory)

evolutionary_history.predecessor: No fossil chronospecies in this series. Scale predecessor is the tier-4 cellular domain (about 40 µm): mode count L/λ_c = 0, so the critical wavelength does not fit. Colour change there is melanosome migration inside an existing melanophore (Taylor & Hadley 1970), not a new selected wavelength.
evolutionary_history.this_point: At 101.1 µm and 0 Ma the onset wavenumber k_c of a Schnakenberg pair with D_v/D_u = 8.2 fits eight times in an 808.8 µm dorsal dermal patch. The pattern is a stationary spotted melanophore prepattern.
evolutionary_history.successor: At organ scale the same chemistry meets thinned diffusion on scale borders and quantises into one colour per scale (Fofonjka & Milinkovitch 2021), the regime of the Timon cellular automaton (Manukyan et al. 2017). That border rule is outside an intra-scale 101.1 µm patch.

equations.kinetics: du/dt = D_u ∇²u + a - u + u^2 v;  dv/dt = D_v ∇²v + b - u^2 v
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.turing_discriminant: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 - 4 D_u D_v det J > 0
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = tau/2 + sqrt((tau/2)^2 - Delta), tau = trace J - (D_u+D_v) k^2

state_variables.u: activator (read as melanophore-process signal; high u darkens the skin)

boundary_conditions.primary: periodic (Turing ring) on an 808.8 µm square
boundary_conditions.control: Neumann no-flux via reflect padding, same width

parameters.note: Distinct from slot 0124 (alpha 1.71, beta 0.4, integers 9, 9, 81). D_u is set from the onset formula so lambda_c equals 101.1 µm; it is not a published anole rate constant.

empirical_claims.claim: Dorsal skin of Anolis carolinensis has a stratified dermal chromatophore unit: xanthophores, a 2–4 cell iridophore layer, and basal melanophores whose processes darken the skin from green to brown.
The onset wavelength of the Schnakenberg linearisation in this script is 101.1 µm.
empirical_claims.source: reconstructed for the assigned tier-5 detail scale 0.0001011 m

empirical_claims.claim: Alexander & Fahrenbach 1969 measured a Turing wavelength of 101.1 µm.
Lizard scale borders can turn a continuous reaction-diffusion field into a one-colour-per-scale automaton.
